desc: Parse input: read `N`, `K`, and array `A` from stdin.
Handle special cases: if `K == 1`, output `max(A)`; if `K == N`, output XOR of all elements and return.
Initialize the first combination indices as `comb = list(range(K))`.
Iterate over all K-subsets using next-combination algorithm; for each, compute XOR of `A[comb[i]]`, update `max_xor`.
Verify complexity: C(N,K) ≤ 1e6, each step O(K), so total ≤ ~1e9 worst-case but typical K small; ensure code is efficient.
